node.title: Re: LWP::UserAgent & match
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Back in [id://11116031|your question from a month ago] we discussed using [mod://Mojo::DOM] for exactly this task (with example code). Please don't use regular expressions, you won't be happy with the solution in the long run. Note that there's also [mod://Mojo::UserAgent], but if you need to execute JavaScript, see [mod://WWW::Mechanize::Firefox] and [mod://WWW::Mechanize::Chrome]. Also note that you should check Yahoo's TOS about scraping the site.
